Iris (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about pricing/quotas. Two tiny things: 1) how do temporary quota increases work for scheduled deploys? 2) do credits auto-apply for spikes?

Noah (Finance): Short: no auto-crediting for bursts. For hosted customers we can grant one-off credits or short quota bumps via support request. Need 48h lead time ideally. Dedicated customers get faster treatment via their account team.

Lee (Eng): Tech note: rolling deploys can amplify token usage if clients retry or fallback. We don't auto-relax quotas. If you expect a migration or big deploy, please tell infra the window and expected qps.

Iris (Product): Is there any way to whitelist a deploy so it doesn't hit quota?

Noah (Finance): We can't remove billing, but we can provision temporary quota increases or issue credits after the fact if the spike was pre-approved.

Sam (CEO): Long-term goal is an automated "deploy burst" feature with safeguards, but it's not product-ready. Must include caps, anomaly detection, and owner approvals.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: api-service rolling update starts at 09:00 UTC

Tess (SRE): Ops guidance: create a deploy runbook with expected throughput and duration. Tag the ticket as "quota-review" and we can expedite the finance review. Also consider using batch endpoints for bulk jobs.

Lee (Eng): Also, recommend ramping canaries slower (1-2% -> 5%) and freezing nonessential prompt fields to reduce token churn. Cache prefixes where possible.

Iris (Product): Can we get an alert when an org is at 90% of quota pre-deploy?

Noah (Finance): We already support account-level alerts. We can add a pre-configured "pre-deploy" alert in Console as a follow-up. I'll coordinate with Eng.

Iris (Product): Perfect. Could someone add a tiny example alert rule for the docs?

Lee (Eng): Sure, pseudo example:
```
when(cost_last_5m > baseline*1.5)
notify(["#deploy-ops","owner@redwood.com"])
```

Noah (Finance): Action: I'll write a short FAQ and a support-ticket template that PMs can copy into requests. Filing FIN-842.

Sam (CEO): Thanks — action items: Noah to draft FAQ + ticket template, Eng to add pre-deploy alert toggle, Product to publish checklist. Revisit in next ops sync.

Iris (Product): Thanks all. Ping me when the ticket is up. :pray:
